prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 18-cell content-only grid body (9 rows, two columns), every cell physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman in 1960s Italian film-star makeup — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large real pearl drop with a gold clip.

Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, body divided into a 18-cell grid (9 rows, two columns), each cell a different content variant, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 18 cells — 9 horizontal rows stacked top to bottom, crossed by one vertical line down the centre splitting each row into a left and right cell — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere, every cell a genuinely different variant of the same content material family. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell a glass vessel of clear turquoise water with drifting bubbles; right cell a glass vessel of clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell a glass vessel of clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars; right cell a glass vessel of clear emerald-green water with drifting water lilies. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell a glass vessel of clear amethyst-violet water with soft drifting moonbeams; right cell a glass vessel of clear citrine-gold water with drifting fireflies. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell a glass vessel of clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes; right cell a glass vessel of clear coral-pink water with drifting light. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell a glass vessel of clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers; right cell a glass vessel of clear topaz-gold water with drifting light. Row 6 (left / right body band 6): left cell a glass vessel of clear ruby-red water with drifting embers of light; right cell a glass vessel of clear jade-green water with drifting leaves. Row 7 (left / right body band 7): left cell a glass vessel of clear sunset-orange water with drifting butterflies; right cell a glass vessel of clear violet water with drifting lavender petals. Row 8 (left / right body band 8): left cell a glass vessel of clear silver water with rising bubbles; right cell a glass vessel of clear golden water with drifting sparkles. Row 9 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip): left cell a glass vessel of clear teal water with drifting seashells, sealing shut at its tip; right cell a glass vessel of clear lavender water with drifting stars, sealing shut at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a bright cobalt blue on one side and a warm golden yellow on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and yellow light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
